[[Tahravohr Garifiz]] is a gardener at the Garden of Seborhin who has a glorified perception of his occupation. He can be found wandering around the southern area of the [[Garden of Seborhin]]'s central plaza.

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Garden of Seborhin}} (near the southwestern entrance of the garden compound)

==Dialogue==
:''"Gardener? How dare you! I learned my craft in the [[Halls of Chokhin|great Library]] of [[Vabbi]]. I read books by ancient scribes on detailing weather patterns of [[Elona]] for the past four centuries. I've clipped every bud and stem in here by hand. My work is an art."''

==Quotes==
:''"Look at this magnificent bloom. Three days, no more, and it will be just a memory. Time is the enemy of all living things, moving us from bud to blossom to decaying mass in an unwavering heartbeat."''
:''"When you give a flower to someone, all you're saying is, "Hey! I killed this innocent creature for your amusement!" Now tell me...how, exactly, is that romantic?"''
